description.zh: 列出信封与模板、查询签署进度、发起新的签署流程。适合确认合同是否已签或提醒补签。首次连接在浏览器登录 Docusign 授权。
description.en: List envelopes and templates, check signature progress, and start a new signing flow. Useful for confirming whether a contract is signed or nudging someone to sign. Sign in to Docusign in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Docusign 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Docusign and authorize on first connect
